dedup_rule: one issue per repo+sha256(sorted changed-file-set) cluster; earliest queue rank kept
document: G3-C.1 pre-registered dual-queue selection; frozen BEFORE any build/execution; no model output consulted.

enrichment_rule.R_TRAP: xfail/skip/flaky marker in test_patch OR test_patch adds a new tests/ file
enrichment_rule.inputs: frozen wave2 gates (f2p/p2p declared counts) + maintainer test_patch text + candidate changed files
enrichment_rule.interpretation: enriched-sample rates estimate CONDITIONAL error behaviour among screen-positive issues, NOT the natural population rate

natural_rate_note: natural oracle ACCEPT/REJECT/NEED prevalence is measured after the build and reported in g3c1_report; the natural ORDER above is frozen now.

screening_funnel.rule: locally cached wave2 candidate pool (frozen audit)
all six frozen wave2 gates must pass
